Approved TED 2020 · Ongoing SC formulation development + label expansion

OPTIC trial (NEJM 2020): 83% vs 10% proptosis responder rate. IV Q3W×8 infusion. Hearing loss/tinnitus up to 30%, muscle cramps, hyperglycemia. $28B Amgen acquisition (Oct 2023). SC formulation in development but safety gaps (hearing loss) remain. Relapses in ~40% of patients within 12–18 months — maintenance need unaddressed.

Phase 2 THRIVE trial. Anti-IGF-1R mAb designed to maintain teprotumumab mechanism but improve tolerability. IV formulation. Ph2 data read-out is the key competitive signal for next-gen IGF-1R approach. Also developing VRDN-003 (SC formulation).

SC formulation anti-IGF-1R mAb. Phase 2 THRIVE-2. Addresses route of administration gap vs. teprotumumab. Viridian's most important program. If VRDN-003 shows efficacy SC, partially closes the teprotumumab administration gap but does not address the TSHR co-activation mechanism.

First oral IGF-1R inhibitor in TED. Small molecule. Phase 3 OPTIC trial. If positive, creates an oral option but still IGF-1R only — does not address TSHR co-activation. Key BD read: oral + injectable differentiation validates IGF-1R as a druggable target for multiple formats including bispecifics.

Anti-CD19 B-cell depleter in TED. Logic: eliminate TRAb-producing B cells/plasma cells. Different mechanism from receptor blockade — addresses the autoantibody source. If EQUAL is positive, validates autoantibody reduction as sufficient for TED — tailwind for FcRn approaches but confirms market is looking for diverse TED mechanisms.

Anti-CD40 mAb blocking B-T cell co-stimulation → reduces TRAb production. Phase 2 in Graves' hyperthyroidism and TED. Mechanistically different — upstream immunosuppression vs. receptor-level blockade. Novartis strategic move validating the TED market beyond Amgen.
